title: Scalar mate followed by the tensor counit computes the ordinary model map
statement: Use [new-integral-residue-tensor-model] and [new-integral-residue-derived-pull-square]. Fix a prime ℓ, a normed field E over ℚ_ℓ, f:X→Y, and any integral homotopy complex P on Y. Write F,B,B',H,εX,e,eH,a as in the explicit let constructions in the Lean statement: e identifies the pulled-back restricted residue coefficient with B', eH is its homotopy image, and a is the exact-F derived counit at P. The restriction/pullback comparison at reduction(Qh P), then restriction of the inverse scalar-extension pull comparison, then H(a), then εX(Fh P), then Qh of homotopyTensorSingleIso(B') inverse followed by eH inverse tensor identity, equals residueExchangeTensorModelMap at P. No tensor-pull presentation, tensor-model target, or derived oplax tensor comparison occurs in this formula; no flatness of P, f, or the coefficient is assumed.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 and proof of Lemma 6.5.9(5), p. 51; explicit formal normalization by derived counits (agent calculation, not a separate statement in the paper)

proof.text: Reuse scalar_mate_counit from IntegralResiduePullFlatModelMateNormalized: it gives extension-counit compatibility for every homotopy complex without a flatness assumption. Its proof is the generic derived-adjunction unit factorization and ordinary scalar-unit calculation.

Invert the derived scalar pull isomorphism and apply exact restriction. Naturality of the restriction/pullback comparison and its factorization identify the restricted counit square. Expand the tensor-presentation counit into extension counit, exact restriction factor and ordinary tensor presentation.

Apply the ordinary homotopy tensor normalization to P and map its equality through Qh. This is the complete ordinary balanced-tensor part of the argument, including the coefficient isomorphism eH and the single-tensor comparison.
Naturality of the exact integral pullback counit at the Y tensor presentation identifies the resulting composite with the definition of tensorModelMap. No counit or tensor-model map is inverted.

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidue_scalarCounit_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ)) :
    let F := (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧
    let B := residueExchangeOrdinaryCoefficient ℓ E Y
    let B' := residueExchangeOrdinaryCoefficient ℓ E X
    let A := Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)
    let SX := Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) X)
    letI := residueOrdinaryUpperStarMonoidal A f
    let e : F.obj B ≅ B' :=
      residueOrdinaryRestrictedRegularPullIso (integralCoeff ℓ E) A
        (integralReductionMap ℓ E) f
    let eH : (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj (Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B) ≅
      Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B' := (F.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (.up ℤ)).app
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj B) ≪≫
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).mapIso
        ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app B ≪≫
          (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).mapIso e)
    let φX := coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) X
    let H := residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X ⋙ residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E X
    let εX : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ H ⟶
        (tensorLeft B').mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh := by
      unfold H B' residueExchangeOrdinaryCoefficient
        residueExchangeReduction integralReduction residueExchangeRestriction
      exact Mod.tensorPresentationDerivedCounit φX
    let M := DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P
    let a : (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj M ⟶
        DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) :=
      (residueExchangeUpperStarCounit (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).app P
    (residueExchangeRestrictPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app
          ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E Y).obj M) ≫
      (residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E X).map
        (((residueExchangePullComparisons ℓ E).pull f).inv.app M) ≫
      H.map a ≫
      εX.app
        ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        ((homotopyTensorSingleIso B').inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          eH.inv ▷ (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
      residueExchangeTensorModelMap ℓ E f P
